title: Partner Gate: Assurance tiers, insurance offsets, and self-serve audit portal experiments
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Summary:
Run a set of coordinated experiments to reduce friction in enterprise procurement by introducing: 1) Assurance tiers (packaged evidence + SLA bundles), 2) Insurance-offset credits that reduce initial reserved capacity commitments, and 3) a lightweight self-serve audit portal that collects SOC2 artifacts and triages evidence for legal review. Goal is to increase conversion for mid-market and lower-friction enterprise signups while keeping legal and security risk bounded.

Background/context:
Enterprise procurement cycles often stall on two axes: evidence collection (customers need SOC2-related artifacts and clarity) and up-front financial commitments (reserved capacity/minimums). Current playbooks are heavy and require Solutions/Legal involvement; this experiment seeks to codify repeatable, productized levers to accelerate procurement without increasing enterprise risk.

What we're testing:
- Whether an "Assurance Tier" product (bronze/silver/gold) with curated artifact bundles and SLA promises increases RFP responsiveness and shortens sales cycles.
- Whether offering an "insurance offset" (a negotiated credit applied to a first-year reserved commit in exchange for verified insurance evidence) increases signed reserved contracts for risk-averse customers.
- Whether a self-serve Audit Portal that ingests and validates common SOC2 artifacts reduces Solutions/Legal touch-time and speeds time-to-contract.

Success metrics:
- Funnel: demo -> contract executed conversion +10% for targeted cohorts (mid-market fintech, healthcare dev teams)
- Time-to-contract median reduced by 20% within cohort
- Legal/Solutions touch-time per deal reduced by 30% (measured via issue tracking and logs)
- No increase in post-sale incidents attributable to lower assurance (track via support & incident tags)

Scope and out-of-scope:
In scope: tier definitions, artifact checklist, portal prototype (upload + automated checklist), pricing experiment matrix, sample contract language for insurance offsets, pilot with 6 customers.
Out of scope: full SOC2 attestation service, bespoke contract negotiation automation, on-prem deployment of the portal (pilot will be hosted).
acceptance_criteria: Assurance tiers defined and documented with explicit artifact list and SLA table
Prototype Audit Portal available for pilot customers (upload, checklist, status) and linked to CR 1002 for storage
Pricing experiment matrix with 3 pricing permutations and clear measurement plan
Legal has reviewed and signed off on sample insurance-offset clause
Pilot run with at least 4 customers and conversion/time-to-contract metrics captured
